evaluation_window.execution_convention: Strict Zero-Lookahead: EOD signal on day t -> executed at day t+1 Open

tp_modes_meta.summary_en: Collar exits immediately at VIX/3M >= 1.10 to unlock Call cap; Naked Put ignores shallow inversions until strictly ITM (QQQ <= K_P); + 5x slow-bear lock (DTE <= 45).
tp_modes_meta.summary_zh: 次仓领口见 VIX/3M >= 1.10 立刻止盈解封卖 Call；首仓裸 Put 浅跌无视倒挂，必须跌破自身行权价 (QQQ <= K_P) 进入实值才平；叠加后半程 DTE <= 45 & Put >= 5x 慢熊锁利。

tp_modes_meta.summary_en: Both slots exit at next Open whenever VIX/3M >= 1.10 panic inversion triggers, or on second-half 5x slow-bear lock (DTE <= 45).
tp_modes_meta.summary_zh: 双槽统一：只要触发 VIX/3M >= 1.10 恐慌倒挂即次日开盘止盈抄底，或后半程 DTE <= 45 且 Put >= 5x 慢熊锁利。

tp_modes_meta.summary_en: Both slots require VIX/3M >= 1.10 AND Put Bid >= 4x entry cost (filters shallow spikes like 2018-10 and 2026-11), plus 5x slow-bear lock (DTE <= 45).
tp_modes_meta.summary_zh: 双槽统一：必须同时满足 VIX/3M >= 1.10 且 Put 涨超 4 倍成本才认恐慌止盈（过滤 2018-10 与 2026-11 浅跌假倒挂），叠加后半程 DTE <= 45 & Put >= 5x 慢熊锁利。

cc_modes_meta.summary_en: Zero normal-time covered calls; 100% uncapped upside during bull melt-ups.
cc_modes_meta.summary_zh: 平时不卖 Call，牛市主升浪 100% 零封顶损耗，仅在危机信号触发时开启保护。

cc_modes_meta.label_zh: 全天候 12Δ · Delta 0.35 止损（推荐 · 0穿最稳）
cc_modes_meta.summary_en: Whenever within 3% of ATH (any VXN), sells 25D 12-Delta (min +5% OTM) Calls and exits early at Delta >= 0.35 before Gamma explodes -> 0 expiry breaches in 12 years, active 11/12 years, highest real-Friday stability.
cc_modes_meta.summary_zh: 距前高 ≤ 3%（不限 VXN）持续卖 25D 12Δ（保底 +5% OTM）Call，在 Call Delta 升至 0.35（仍在虚值、Gamma 未爆前）即次日开盘止损平仓——11 年常卖、12 年 0 穿价、实盘周五到期表现最稳。

cc_modes_meta.label_zh: 全天候 12Δ · Delta 0.45 展期 Roll（30D 上移）
cc_modes_meta.summary_en: Whenever within 3% of ATH, sells 25D 12-Delta Calls; when Delta >= 0.45, buys back and immediately rolls out +30D to a fresh higher 12-Delta strike -> positive across all 21D-30D & Friday tenors, 11y active.
cc_modes_meta.summary_zh: 距前高 ≤ 3% 全天候卖 25D 12Δ Call；当 Delta 升至 0.45 时立刻平旧仓并同步展期 30 天上移至新 12Δ 高行权价——认小亏拉大安全垫，21D–30D 与实盘周五全期限稳正。

cc_modes_meta.label_zh: 全天候 12Δ · Delta 0.55 零成本 Roll（45D）
cc_modes_meta.summary_en: Whenever within 3% of ATH, sells 25D 12-Delta Calls; when Delta >= 0.55, attempts a zero-cost credit roll out +45D to the highest OTM strike covering the buyback (closes cleanly if no OTM credit roll exists) -> highest 25D upside.
cc_modes_meta.summary_zh: 距前高 ≤ 3% 全天候卖 25D 12Δ Call；当 Delta 升至 0.55 时尝试向后展期 45 天做零成本上移 Roll（若已无虚值零成本可展则直接平仓不硬扛）——25D 账面弹性最高、最大回撤压至 -29.9%。

sp_modes_meta.summary_en: Engine 3 disabled (0 margin interest, max stock leverage strictly 1.00x). Preserves canonical 2D Long-Put x Covered-Call baselines.
sp_modes_meta.summary_zh: 关闭第三引擎（0 融资利息、股票总敞口严格 1.00x），完全保留原双引擎基准曲线。

sp_modes_meta.summary_en: Sells 14D 5% OTM Put on VIX/VIX3M >= 1.00 capped at <= 10% equity; if assigned, sells 14D Wheel Call at max(K_assign, 1.02*S) until called away -> Calmar 0.677, MaxDD -29.82%, $817 12-yr interest.
sp_modes_meta.summary_zh: VIX/VIX3M >= 1.00 卖 14D 5% OTM Put（名义严控 <= 10% 净值）；若接货立即按 max(接货价, 现价+2%) 卖 14D Wheel Call 直至被 Call 走去杠杆——Calmar 升至 0.677 全场第一、最大回撤压至 -29.82%、12 年融资利息仅 $817。

sp_modes_meta.summary_en: Requires VIX/VIX3M >= 1.00 AND VIX[t] < VIX[t-1] (panic cresting) before selling 10D 5% OTM Put (<= 20% cap) + Reverse Wheel -> 29 trades, 4 assignments, only $505 12-yr interest.
sp_modes_meta.summary_zh: 要求 VIX/VIX3M >= 1.00 且当日 VIX 回落（VIX[t] < VIX[t-1] 恐慌见顶拐头）才卖 10D 5% OTM Put（<= 20% 名义帽）+ 接货反向 Wheel——12 年仅 29 笔、4 次接货、总融资利息仅 $505。

sp_modes_meta.label_zh: 14D 无过滤（20%帽 · 收益冠军）
sp_modes_meta.summary_en: Sells 14D 5% OTM Put whenever VIX/VIX3M >= 1.00 capped at <= 20% equity + Reverse Wheel -> $1,846,992 terminal NAV (+43.37% extra QQQ shares), 89.1% win rate.
sp_modes_meta.summary_zh: 只要 VIX/VIX3M >= 1.00 即卖 14D 5% OTM Put（<= 20% 名义帽）+ 接货反向 Wheel——终值达 $1,846,992 全场最高（多攒 +43.37% QQQ 份额），46 笔胜率 89.1%。

crisis_windows.narrative_en: 4/6 Crisis Lights + AD top-divergence armed two 90-DTE Collars ahead of the peak ($110.64 on 6/01 and $112.73 on 7/23). On 2015-08-24 when VIX/VIX3M spiked to 1.194, both tranches monetized at $94.23 Open for +$13,633 (+144.6 QQQ shares), cutting QQQ's -13.94% drawdown nearly in half.

crisis_windows.narrative_en: In 2022's frog-boiling grind, VIX/VIX3M peaked at just 1.022 (<1.10), so panic-inversion TP never fired. Track-2 Dual-TP (DTE<=45 & Put>=5x) stepped in on 2022-02-24 Open @$318.84 (32 DTE left, 5x+ deep ITM), harvesting +$37,680 (+121.86 extra QQQ shares!) right before March's dead-cat bounce, slashing 2022 MDD from -35.12% to -31.52% (+3.60% excess)!

crisis_windows.title_zh: 2024-08 日元套息交易平仓闪崩 (-13.6%)
crisis_windows.narrative_en: 4/6 Crisis Lights + AD divergence opened two 50% option slots right into the summer peak ($455.50 on 5/30 and $497.62 on 7/16). When the Yen carry unwind pushed VIX/VIX3M to 1.144 on 2024-08-05, both slots monetized at $437.23 Open on 8/06 for +$35,158 (+80.39 QQQ shares), slashing DD from -13.56% to -8.05% (+5.51% excess)!

Even with macro lights at only 2/6, US Liquid AD Line < 50DMA top-divergence caught the $539.52 top and opened a 50% Collar on 2025-02-24 @$527.88 (K_P=$475.09). On 2025-04-07 Open @$408.66 (VIX/3M 1.234), that single tranche harvested +$76,729 (+187.70 QQQ shares at the exact bottom!), slashing DD to -16.36% (+6.41% excess)!
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 即便宏观灯仅亮 2 盏，全美 AD Line < 50DMA 顶背离依然死死咬住 $539.52 大顶，于 2/24 @$527.88 开启 50% 保护（K_P=$475.09）；4/07 关税恐慌极值（倒挂 1.234）在 $408.66 铁底单笔暴赚 +$76,729，一把抄底 +187.70 股 QQQ，回撤压至 -16.36%（超额高达 +6.41%）！

crisis_windows.title_en: 2026-08 to 2026-11 LIVE Pure-Options Campaign (-19.9% QQQ vs -17.5% U1)

crisis_windows.narrative_en: 1) 8/31 Slot 1 Naked Put @$715.17 (K_P=$643.65, NO Call cap -> captured 100% of the rally to $759.66 ATH!). 2) 10/05 Slot 2 Zero-Cost Collar @$749.35 (K_P=$674.41). 3) On 11/05 VIX/3M=1.103: Slot 2 Collar (already deep ITM) monetized on 11/06 Open @$658.35 for +$50,384 (+76.51 QQQ shares) and freed the Call cap, while Slot 1 Naked Put IGNORED the shallow inversion ($647.05 > $643.65 OTM) and rode the real crash down to $608.45 (-19.9%), arming deep-ITM panic TP (+$39,532 MTM / +67.32 sh) for next Open — cutting drawdown to -14.81% (+5.09% excess)!
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: ① 8/31 AD 背离开启首仓 50% 裸 Put @$715.17（行权 $643.65，无卖 Call 封顶吃满冲顶至 $759.66！）；② 10/05 见顶前一日 @$749.35 补齐次仓 50% 零成本 Collar（行权 $674.41）；③ 11/05 压线倒挂 1.103：次仓领口已深实值，11/06 开盘果断落袋 +$50,384（+76.51 股）并解除卖 Call 封顶；首仓裸 Put 因收盘 $647.05 尚未跌破行权价 $643.65 直接无视浅倒挂，稳稳拿住吃到 11/20 深跌至 $608.45（-19.9%），实值恐慌止盈正式触发（浮盈 +$39,532 / +67.32 股待次日开盘换股），将本轮回撤从 -19.90% 压至 -14.81%（超额 +5.09%）！
